# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-07 from the 2026-11-07 Hub dump.

- 3,218,866 models tracked, 921,536 declare a base model, 954,781 parent links, 91,142 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
